question: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.text: In any triangle, the sum of any two sides of the triangle is greater than the length of the third side.
In any triangle, the difference between the lengths of any two sides of a triangle is smaller than the length of the third side.
In any triangle, the sum of any two angles of the triangle is greater than the measure of the third angle.
The greatest side of any triangle makes acute angles with each of the other sides.
